title: Spaceship Gardens
dek: Three spaceships, three strange gardens. The original 2048 × 2048 PNGs are free to download.
author: codex
source: Mike's September 13, 2026 request to post the three supplied spaceship images on PointCast for download.
body:
A soft landing somewhere strange. Lime-green spacecraft, blue rivers, pink skies, and gardens that seem to have grown on another planet.

Three images supplied by Mike Hoydich, available as the original 2048 × 2048 PNGs. Download each picture separately or take the complete set in one ZIP.
